title: 第14章 狼，密谋
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
吃过午饭，陆林背上六力弓出门。

    时间就只剩一天。

    他得抓紧时间凑齐银子。

    今天守在村口的人换成了陆方。

    看到陆林出村，陆方等了一会才飞快跑向孙府。

    “孙哥，孙哥，陆林背着弓出村了，看那方向是要进山。”

    陆方喘着粗气。

    “进山了？”

    孙友成心中大定，眼睛一眯。

    “天堂有路你不走，既然你自己找死，那就怪不得我了。”

    “陆方，你叫上志刚，陆杨，跟着一起进山。”

    “若是有机会，就直接弄死陆林。”

    “孙哥放心，到时候动手的事就交给陆杨，等陆林一死，咱们就告官抓他。”

    “到时候，陆杨的那个婆娘就是孙哥一人独享了。”

    陆方笑的猥琐。

    “诶，不必折腾陆杨。”

    孙友成脸上带着莫名的笑意，“留着他，玩起来才有意思，到时候，老子就当着陆杨的面，跟他媳妇颠鸾倒凤，那滋味，想想都美妙啊，哈哈哈。”

    “哈哈哈，孙哥高明，那我就先去了。”

    陆方赔笑几声，出门叫上孙志刚和陆杨，三人拿着刀出村。

    ……

    想要一次性弄到九两银子，那就要猎一头大家伙。

    野猪。

    黑熊。

    大虫。

    亦或者是花豹，獐子，冬鹿。

    想来想去，陆林还是决定先去荆棘丛那边碰碰运气。

    这过了好几天，冬鹿群的警惕性应该也松懈下来不少。

    一路前行。

    陆林穿过荆棘灌木，还没到那一片针叶林，就看到十几头冬鹿双腿搭在树干上，身体直立，伸长脖子去够高处的针叶。

    陆林双目一亮。

    “来得早不如来得巧。”

    “这下春税的银子有了。”

    陆林伏低身子，靠近针叶林。

    箭术进入炉火纯青境界后，他的目力越发惊人。

    隔着五六十步远，都能清晰的看到冬鹿身上的毛发。

    那一头断角冬鹿，仍旧守在林子边缘，偶尔吃一口，大多数时间都在警惕着。

    “上一次来，我还惧怕这断角冬鹿，现在，就让它作为我的战利品吧。”

    断角冬鹿的体型硕大。

    一头能顶得上两头母鹿。

    它的皮毛光顺柔亮，在阳光下泛起亮眼的光泽。

    那断角也是生的颇为狰狞，想必有不少富户喜欢这一口。

    再说句难听的，哪怕卖鹿肉，这断角冬鹿的肉都能卖十两银子。

    就它了！

    陆林端起六力弓，搭上破甲箭。
content_en:
After lunch, Lu Lin put the Liuli Bow on his back and went out.

    There is only one day left.

    He had to hurry up and collect the money.

    Today, the person guarding the village entrance was replaced by Lu Fang.

    Seeing Lu Lin leaving the village, Lu Fang waited for a while before running quickly to the Sun Mansion.

    "Brother Sun, Brother Sun, Lu Lin has left the village with his bow on his back. Looking at that direction, he is heading into the mountains."

    Lu Fang gasped.

    "Going into the mountains?"

    Sun Youcheng was determined and narrowed his eyes.

    "There is a road to heaven and you don't take it. Since you are seeking death, you can't blame me."

    "Lu Fang, call Shang Zhigang and Lu Yang, and follow us into the mountain."

    "If there is a chance, I will kill Lu Lin directly."

    "Brother Sun, don't worry. I'll leave it to Lu Yang to take action when the time comes. Once Lu Lin dies, we will sue the officials and arrest him."

    "At that time, Lu Yang's wife will be exclusive to Brother Sun."

    Lu Fang smiled obscenely.

    "Hey, there's no need to bother Lu Yang."

    Sun Youcheng had an inexplicable smile on his face, "Keep him, it will be fun to play with. Then, I will be Lu Yang's face and have an affair with his wife. It's wonderful to think about it, hahaha."

    "Hahaha, Brother Sun is smart, so I'll go first."

    Lu Fang laughed a few times and went out to call Sun Zhigang and Lu Yang. The three of them left the village with knives.

    …

    If you want to get nine taels of silver at once, you have to hunt a big guy.

    wild boar.

    black bear.

    Big bug.

    Or maybe it's a leopard, a deer, or a winter deer.

    After much deliberation, Lu Lin decided to try his luck at the thorn bush first.

    After several days, the winter deer herd's vigilance should have relaxed a lot.

    Keep going.

    Lu Lin passed through the thorn bushes, and before he reached the coniferous forest, he saw a dozen winter deer with their legs on the tree trunks, standing upright and stretching their necks to reach the needles high up.

    Lu Lin's eyes lit up.

    "It's better to come early than to come late."

    "Now we have money from the spring tax."

    Lu Lin lowered his body and got close to the coniferous forest.

    After his archery skills reached the level of proficiency, his eyesight became even more astonishing.

    From fifty or sixty steps away, you can clearly see the hair on the winter deer.

    The winter deer with broken horns was still guarding the edge of the forest, occasionally taking a bite, but most of the time it was on guard.

    "The last time I came here, I was still afraid of this winter deer with broken horns. Now, let it be my trophy."

    The hornless winter deer is huge in size.

    One can hold up two does.

    Its fur is smooth and shiny, shining brightly in the sun.

    The severed horn is also quite ferocious, and many rich people must like it.

    To put it bluntly, even if you sell venison, the meat of this winter deer with broken horns can be sold for ten taels of silver.

    That’s it!

    Lu Lin raised his Liuli bow and set on an armor-piercing arrow.
